name: aw-social-contributions
description: Aruba social contribution reference for 2026 covering AOV and AWW employee and employer rates, AZV health contribution allocation and the new pensioner relief. Includes annual contribution examples, income-limit distinctions, employer-only sickness and accident insurance rates, and the annual Cessantia amount. Use for Aruba payroll insurance, SVB rates, pensioner AZV or employer contribution questions. The scope is rate calculation once insured status and contribution income have been established. It excludes net-pay calculations, individual coverage decisions, partial-year limits, benefit entitlement and unresolved sickness or accident threshold mechanics.
